composition_subtypes.role: Sort intervals by start to sweep in order
Max-heap tracks active segment max end for each start

payload.core_composition_summary: Sort column non-decreasing segments by start, then sweep with max-heap to compute per-start maximum covered end for O(1) queries.
payload.rationale: The solution coordinates sorting and a priority queue: it first sorts intervals by start (sorting_custom_key) and then processes them with a max-heap (ds_heap_priority_queue) to efficiently answer range queries. This is a classic sweep-line composition.
